The '''Dehydrator''' is a type of [[Crafting#Artisan Equipment|Artisan Equipment]] that is used to create [[Dried Mushrooms]], [[Dried Fruit]], or [[Raisins]]. It can be crafted after purchasing the recipe from [[Pierre]] for {{Price|10000}}. It is also a possible reward as the 12th prize from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|Prize Machine]] in the Mayor's Manor (50% chance). One is included in the [[The Cave|Farm Cave]] if the player chooses the mushroom option.

==Products==
Dehydrator requires five [[:Category:Mushrooms|Mushrooms]] (except [[Red Mushroom]]) or [[Fruits]] of the same '''type''' and '''quality'''.

==Notes==
* The quality of the dried product is always normal and '''not''' affected by the quality of items used.
* Inedible fruits become edible after being turned into [[Dried Fruit]]. The formula for [[Energy]] is: <samp>[Base fruit sell price ÷ 2 × 0.5 × 5]</samp>, or <samp>[Base fruit sell price × 1.25]</samp>. ''This is the same as the calculation for base silver quality sell price, but rounded instead of truncated.''
**Dried [[Ancient Fruit]]s give 688 [[Energy]] and 309 [[Health]]
**Dried [[Coconut]]s give 125 [[Energy]] and 56 [[Health]]
**Dried [[Rhubarb]]s give 275 [[Energy]] and 123 [[Health]]
* The dehydrator effectively makes the [[:Category:Mushrooms|Mushrooms]] or [[Fruits]] sell at gold quality price +5 each.
* [[Truffle]]s are not classified as [[:Category:Mushrooms|mushrooms]] and therefore cannot be placed into the Dehydrator.

The '''Fish Smoker''' is a type of [[Crafting#Artisan Equipment|Artisan Equipment]] that is used to create [[Smoked Fish|smoked fish]] using any [[fish]] and 1 [[coal]]. It doubles the sell price of a fish while retaining quality, as well as multiplying the [[energy]] and [[health]] restoration by 1.5 (if that fish restored energy or health, otherwise the value remains unchanged).<ref name="energy" /> The smoker accepts [[Fish#Legendary Fish|Legendary Fish]] as well as [[Crab Pot]] specific fish, making the latter edible.<ref name="inedible" />

It can be crafted after purchasing the recipe from the [[Fish Shop]] for {{Price|10000}}. It is also a possible reward as the 12th prize from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|Prize Machine]] in the Mayor's Manor (50% chance). Players on the [[Farm Maps#Riverland|Riverland Farm]] start with one Fish Smoker.

Iridium quality doubles the base sell price of Wine. Wine takes the longest to age of any item in [[Cask]]s. It takes 2 seasons of aging to go from basic wine to iridium quality wine. '''Maple Syrup''' is [[Trees|Tree]] sap made from the [[Tapper]] when it is placed on a [[Maple Tree]], taking {{duration|9 days|class=inline}}, or {{duration|4 days|class=inline}} with a [[Heavy Tapper]].

Maple Syrup can be obtained by tapping [[Maple Tree]]s grown by the player or growing naturally in Stardew Valley (''e.g.,'' in [[Cindersap Forest]]). It can also rarely be obtained after processing [[Hardwood]] in a [[Wood Chipper]].

Although Maple Syrup is labeled "Artisan Good" in-game, it does not benefit from the [[Skills#Farming|Artisan Profession]], but instead from the [[Skills#Foraging|Tapper Profession]] (+25% sell price).

==Tailoring==
Maple Syrup can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Floppy Beanie|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a brown dye when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
*One Maple Syrup is required to complete the [[Quests#Strange Note|"Strange Note" quest]] that is triggered by reading [[Secret Notes#Secret Note #23|Secret Note #23]].
*One or two Maple Syrup may be requested by several fish in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]].

If Raisins are placed in a [[Junimo Hut]], then the Junimos have a 20% chance to double harvest crops.<ref name="harvest" />

'''Jellies''' and '''Pickles''' can be produced by inserting either a [[Fruits|fruit]] or a [[Vegetables|vegetable]] / [[Foraging#Foraged Items|foraged item]] in a [[Preserves Jar|preserves jar]], respectively. The value of a single jar of jelly or pickles is equal to (2 * Base [[Crops|Crop]] Value + 50). Jelly and pickles are unaffected by the quality of the fruit or vegetable used.

A [[Preserves Jar|preserves jar]] requires 4000 minutes, or 2-3 days, to produce jelly or pickles.<ref name="timing details" />

*One Pickles is requested by the Raccoon at the [[Giant Stump]] as part of his fourth request. It may also be requested as part of any request starting with the sixth.

==Trivia==

*Pickles sold by the [[Traveling Cart]] will not be of any vegetable type and will sell for {{Price|100}} ({{Price|140}} with the [[Skills#Farming|Artisan Profession]]).
*The description of the [[Preserves Jar]] states that it makes Jam, but it actually produces Jelly.

{{History|1.0|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.4|Jas & Vincent no longer hate Jelly, they like it.  Jellies and Pickles can now be used in Tailoring. Can be requested in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]].}}
{{History|1.6|Jellies and Pickles now change color depending on the item used to make them. Jellies and Pickles are now consumable. Positive energy foraged items can now be made into Pickles. Both Jelly and Pickles are now requested by the Raccoon.}}
{{History|1.6.2|Fixed inedible items becoming poisonous after being turned into jelly or pickles.}}
